name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Sixteen pancakes, and he didn't even start the first three games. So which is it, gentlemen, the trenches or the quarterbacks?

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Well, Renee, you gotta look at the whole picture. Marcel Reed is an electric runner, but Split Zone Duo says he's not a top-tier passer. That puts pressure on the coaching to adjust.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, Evan Henry threw down 16 pancakes and gave up just 1.5 sacks over 350 pass plays in 2020. You tell me if that line ain't the clutch factor.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Cassius, that's a solid line, no doubt, but Reed's mobility and ability to make those 'wow' throws, even if inconsistent, can neutralize a tough front.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, even the sickest QB can’t run through a wall that ain’t move. Control the line, you control the game clock and the playbook. That’s fundamentals, no cap.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Cassius, that stat line is from 2020. What's your source that Henry's game translates the same way this season?

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Renee, that's a fair point. But even with a strong line, you still need the quarterback to make the plays, and Reed’s mobility forces a defensive coordinator to get creative.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, Evan Henry came out as a three-star recruit, still got eligibility left to sharpen his game. That’s the fresh energy in the trenches South Carolina State needed, no debate.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: A three-star recruit, still got eligibility? Okay, Cassius, that's a real talent upgrade for the trenches, but even a fresh line needs a game plan to stop a dynamic runner like Reed.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Coaching and QBs bring questions, but that O-line upgrade? That’s a fact. You win the line, you make all the noise, plain and simple.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Look, Cassius, an O-line upgrade is definitely a piece of the puzzle, but Marcel Reed's dynamic playmaking can still shift the whole game plan and force an audible from the defense.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Andrew, notice what you keep circling and never landing: you keep saying Reed 'can' shift the game plan, never that he does, on tape, this year.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, coaching's part of it, for sure, but you can’t scheme up 16 pancakes and near-impenetrable pass lanes. That line's the foundation, Reed's just the highlight reel on top.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Look, Cassius, you're right, those pancakes are real, but even a great line can't cover for a quarterback who can't consistently connect on throws downfield, and Marcel Reed can make those wow throws.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Both of you keep handing me potential, not proof, so here's where it stands: trenches confirmed, quarterback debated. We'll dig into the coaching angle next week.
